metadata.timing_semantics: Inclusive spans; totals can overlap. Percentiles use recent bounded samples.
metadata.sampling_semantics: Python stack locations only; native/GPU work appears at its Python caller. Sampling can be delayed by code holding the GIL.

process.cpu_percent_semantics: Process CPU / wall time × 100; 100% equals one logical CPU. Machine percent divides by logical processor count.
process.gui_thread_cpu_semantics: CPU time of the constructing thread (GUI only when constructed there), not GUI wall time.
process.private_bytes_semantics: Private committed bytes (PrivateUsage); not resident memory.

instrumentation.timings: Inclusive wall time; nested spans overlap. Not GPU execution or presentation time.
instrumentation.sampling: GUI Python stack; native calls may hold the GIL and delay the sampler.
instrumentation.content: Entity IDs and structural metadata only; no artwork, text content or local variables.
instrumentation.already_connected_slots: Included in enclosing operation spans and sampled stacks.
